metadata.title: RM N° 1053-2020/MINSA, aprueban el Documento Técnico: Manual de Buenas Prácticas de Farmacovigilancia
metadata.edition: Dated 18 December 2020 · El Peruano 20 December 2020 · the Manual applies 90 calendar days later (Art. 2) · only the resolution was read; the Manual annex was not
